subject: First 48h stability checklist and network sanity for FinCheck private deployment
messages:
From: Samir Desai <samir@fincheck.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@fincheck.com>, AWS Account Team <aws-redirect@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-03-18T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment cutover — initial 48h expectations

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the support getting the FinCheck private deployment into our VPC last night. The migration window completed and services appear up from our side, but we'd like to lock down the first-48h checklist so our security and SRE teams know exactly what to watch for.

High-level asks from FinCheck:
- Confirm that session affinity and cross-AZ routing are stable for all model pods.
- Validate KV cache warm-up (we rely on prefix caching for conversational continuity).
- Verify egress/ingress firewall rules (corporate agents report intermittent failures to SSO endpoints).
- Capture latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) for the inference route and for token-level observability.

Can Redwood provide a one-page checklist and an on-call contact for the first 48 hours? If you can also share the exact runbook steps you plan to execute, we can mirror them in our playbook.

We have compliance folks on standby who may request flow logs and packet captures if anything looks off — please let us know how to share these securely.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Desai
VP Product, FinCheck
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Desai <samir@fincheck.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-18T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment cutover — initial 48h expectations

Samir —

Appreciate the note and congrats on getting through the migration window. Short answer: yes — we can run the 48h stability validation and provide a single-sheet checklist and an escalation contact.

I've attached the current runtime runbook (runtime-runbook-v1.3.txt) and a concise checklist spreadsheet. Summary of what we'll run from Redwood side in the next 48h:
- Network: continuous health probes across AZs, BGP/route-table sanity, VPC NACL and SG trace for the inference subnets.
- Serving: KV cache warm-up for top-50 prefixes, model variant fallback verification (low-tier -> high-tier path), and steady-state batching checks.
- Telemetry: p50/p95/p99 latency PSD sampling every 5 minutes, token-level tokenization counts, and token-billing sanity.
- Security: flow logs collection (S3), packet-capture on failure triggers (pcap stubs), and KMS log verification for keys used by private deployment.

On-call: Evelyn Hart (redwood-oncall@redwood.ai) will be primary for infra/network, Karthik will own serving/runtime checks, Naomi will coordinate logs and evidence for FinCheck's compliance team.

I'll kick this off with a sync at 11:00 PT and will post a short triage note afterwards.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Private Deployments, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Desai <samir@fincheck.com>
Date: 2027-03-18T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment cutover — initial 48h expectations

Markus / team —

Quick notes from runtime side after the 11:00 sync:
- KV cache: we ran a warm-up using the FinCheck top-50 prefixes; hit rate rose from 6%->62% after a 20-min warm-up; steady-state expectation ~65% with current traffic profile.
- Model fallbacks: exercised a simulated GPU OOM on one pod — automatic fallback to quantized variant succeeded and request latencies for the fallback path were within SLA (p95 increased by ~180ms).
- Batching: continuous batching target maintained at 3–5ms overhead for this workload.

Attaching the short run script we used (included in runtime-runbook-v1.3.txt). If FinCheck wants us to push a temporary KV pre-warm on their import path we can schedule that — it requires a brief traffic replay window.

Karthik
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Desai <samir@fincheck.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-19T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Network probe results and early anomalies

Samir / team —

We completed the first pass of cross-AZ probes and a focused packet sample for SSO traffic as requested. Key findings:
- Cross-AZ egress is healthy; packet loss on internal mTLS routes is <0.2% across the board.
- We observed intermittent RSTs from a corporate IP block (198.51.100.0/24) to the SSO endpoint between 03:10–03:24 UTC. We pulled flow logs and a 60s pcap window — attached as analysis_pcap_0319.pcap (reference only).
- Route-table check: there was a stale route pointing to an old NAT instance which could cause asymmetric flow for a fraction of requests; we removed the stale route at 03:35 UTC. Post-change probes show restored symmetry.

Action items for FinCheck: please confirm whether your corporate agent fleet uses that 198.51.100/24 block or if it maps to a proxy in your environment — if so, we can coordinate with your infra team to whitelist/mirror.

Evelyn
Network Reliability Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Desai <samir@fincheck.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence bundle and compliance handoff

Samir —

Per your compliance note, attached is the evidence bundle we prepared:
- VPC flow logs export location (S3 link included in Drive folder)
- Packet capture excerpt: analysis_pcap_0319.pcap
- KMS access logs filtered for the deployment key (kek-deploy-ff324)
- Runbook execution log (runbook-exec-20270319.log)

I've pushed the S3 presigned links into the shared Drive folder and applied an ACL that includes FinCheck's security account. If FinCheck needs timestamps in a different timezone or additional traces, let me know and we can expand the window.

Naomi
Security & Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Desai <samir@fincheck.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@fincheck.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-21T17:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment cutover — initial 48h expectations

Team —

Thanks — this is exactly what we needed. The evidence bundle looks complete and our security team has ingested the S3 logs. The intermittent SSO failures were tied to our corporate proxy; we've rotated a rule and are seeing the error rate drop to near-zero.

FinCheck will keep monitors on for the next 72 hours but from a product + compliance perspective we consider this release stable. Appreciated the quick turnaround and the thorough runbook.

I'll close the loop with our procurement team regarding the final compliance attestation later this week.

Best,
Samir
VP Product, FinCheck
